about.title:
Your data,
our priority.
about.intro: DigiScia is a Burkinabe start-up specializing in data science and engineering as well as digital transformation. It supports companies and institutions in the exploitation of their data and the optimization of their processes through innovative solutions based on data, artificial intelligence and software engineering, in order to improve their performance and competitiveness.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Propel companies towards total digital sovereignty. We design fluid data architectures that stand the test of time and volume.

tech.title: Rigorous Engineering
tech.text: We deliver clean, documented, and maintainable code for your teams.

ai.title: Artificial Intelligence
ai.text: Create and integrate AI solutions tailored to your needs. Move from raw data to informed decisions for more strategic decision-making.

sovereignty.title: Sovereignty
sovereignty.text: Your data is your most precious asset. We guarantee its absolute integrity and security.

performance.title: Performance
performance.text: Measurable solutions. We don't sell buzzwords, but concrete results.

partnership.title: Partnership
partnership.text: We co-build with your teams to ensure a real transfer of skills.

services.title: Our Areas of Expertise
services.subtitle: We combine rigorous software engineering and advanced data science to build the digital foundations of your future success.

web.title: Web & Mobile Solutions
web.desc: Tailor-made, high-performance and scalable applications that transform your users' experience.
web.full: In a digital-first world, your digital presence is your main showcase. We don't just write code; we architect complete digital ecosystems.
web.cases: SaaS Platforms, Marketplaces, Client Portals, MVPs.

ai.title: AI & Data Science
ai.desc: Move from raw data to strategic prediction. Automate your business intelligence.
ai.full: Artificial intelligence is an immediate competitive lever. Our Data Scientists transform your data deposits into powerful predictive algorithms.
ai.cases: Smart Chatbots, Fraud Detection, Sentiment Analysis, Logistics.

data.title: Data Engineering
data.desc: Build the foundation of your data strategy. Robust pipelines and guaranteed quality.
data.full: An effective AI strategy relies on healthy data. We build the information highways of your business.

bi.title: Business Intelligence
bi.desc: Visualize to decide. Interactive dashboards that tell the story of your performance.
bi.full: Don't drive blind anymore. We transform the complexity of your metrics into clear and actionable visualizations.

auto.title: Automation & AI Agents
auto.desc: Free your teams from repetitive tasks with autonomous agents.
auto.full: Boost your operational efficiency by delegating complex business processes to our automation solutions.
auto.cases: Automatic lead qualification, Invoicing, Level 1 support, Stocks.
